name: robots/hrjp__easys_sim
title: Easys simulated camera and balloon detector
intro: Easys simulated camera and balloon detector, adapted from hrjp/easys_sim. It runs `capture`. `capture`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/hrjp__easys_sim --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/hrjp__easys_sim --backend fake --mcp
